market_rationale: Stagflationary backdrop: payrolls slowed sharply after revisions, core PCE 3.3% and headline 3.7%, oil up 19% over 21 sessions, diesel near $5.85, and futures price a 58% chance of a September hike with 10y at 4.78%. SPY sits within 1% of its 52-week high, so the index is not pricing this. A hawkish FOMC on September 16 plus CPI/PPI is the key window event. Prefer candidates whose recent relative pullbacks are not tied to the hike/energy risk, and avoid long-duration growth and crypto whose short bursts lack in-window support.
portfolio_rationale: Favor high-quality relative pullbacks with low SPY correlation that are less exposed to a hawkish FOMC: cybersecurity (strong prior trend, shallow drawdown), regional banks (steep curve, stabilized), and copper (improving China orders and broad commodity bid). Avoid extended high-beta semis/Taiwan and crypto lacking in-window support, and treat discretionary, solar, and defense weakness as fundamentally grounded.
